assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of these collapse events, cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods.
Cardiac event monitoring is coded as CPT 93271.
The service supports the diagnosis of I25.10.
The service supports the diagnosis of I34.0.
The service addresses the payer's coverage determination under denial code PR-204.
